meta.title: Barcelona & Mallorca Summer 2027
meta.dates: July 17-30, 2027 (Miami -> Barcelona -> Port de Sóller -> Canyamel -> Miami)

blocks.title: Arrive MIA, check bags
blocks.detail: Arrive 3+ hrs before an international flight with a family of 4.

blocks.title: American Airlines - MIA -> BCN - Nonstop - ~9h15m
blocks.detail: MIA -> BCN, Economy, 4 passengers. Booked via Alaska Atmos Rewards (partner award on American, oneworld) - same booking pattern already confirmed on the Rome trip's AA52 flight. Lands Sunday, July 18 local time Barcelona.
blocks.notes: Estimated at 35,000 Atmos Rewards points + ~$25.60/passenger x 4 = 140,000 points + ~$102.40, mirroring the confirmed real pricing on the MIA-FCO Rome flight (same airline, same distance class). Not yet live-quoted for this specific route/date - confirm exact figure at booking.
blocks.flag: Estimate based on a comparable confirmed fare, not a live quote for this route - verify before booking.

blocks.title: Land at BCN - immigration, bags, customs
Transfer to hotel
blocks.detail: BCN airport -> Barceloneta, ~25-30 min by taxi.

blocks.title: Hotel Arts Barcelona (The Ritz-Carlton) - check in
blocks.detail: 2 Rooms (connecting).
blocks.notes: Category 8 (Marriott's highest tier), fully dynamic pricing now (fixed charts retired 2022-23). Recent tracked point costs run ~75,000-100,000 pts/night/room in peak season - budgeting the midpoint (~85,000) x 2 rooms x 4 nights = 680,000 points. Booking 2 connecting rooms because a standard room isn't confirmed to sleep 2A+2K - the hotel's own family package is explicitly a two-space configuration, not a single room.
blocks.roomType: 2 Connecting Standard Rooms (or inquire re: Family Suite)
blocks.address: Carrer de la Marina 19-21, 08005 Barcelona, Spain
blocks.flag: This is a very large points redemption (680,000 total) - worth comparing directly against a cash rate before booking. Category 8 properties commonly run $700-900+/night cash in peak Barcelona summer, so 2 rooms cash could easily exceed $1,500/night. Call Marriott Reservations to ask specifically about a Family Suite that might sleep 4 in one unit at a lower combined cost.

blocks.title: Downtime at hotel - unpack, freshen up
blocks.detail: Short window after the overnight flight, not extended lounging - the day picks back up at 11.

blocks.title: Barceloneta beach & waterfront walk
blocks.detail: Light orientation walk along Passeig Marítim - no swimming pressure today, just getting bearings and stretching legs after the flight.

blocks.title: Lunch - beachfront xiringuito, Barceloneta
blocks.detail: One of the casual beach-shack restaurants right on the Barceloneta sand - simple grilled fish, salads, sandwiches.

blocks.title: Explore Barceloneta & the Born neighborhood
blocks.detail: Wandering the narrow streets, small shops, and plazas on foot - real city time instead of hotel downtime.

blocks.title: Dinner - Santa Marta
blocks.detail: Near Barceloneta beach. Sandwiches, wood-fired pizza, burgers, salads, outdoor space for kids to roam - easy, casual first night.

blocks.title: Taxi/metro to Sagrada Família
blocks.detail: ~20-25 min from Barceloneta.

blocks.title: Sagrada Família
blocks.detail: Essential Entry + Audio Guide, timed morning slot before heat/crowds.
blocks.notes: €26/adult official Essential Entry (kids under 11 free) -> ~€52/$56 for 2 adults. A 2026 centenary surcharge (€2-5) has applied June-Dec 2026 - verify whether it recurs into 2027. Online-only booking, no physical ticket office - book well ahead. sagradafamilia.org
blocks.flag: No ticket office on-site - must book online in advance, ideally as soon as the booking window allows.

blocks.title: Wander the Eixample around the basilica
Lunch - Semproniana
blocks.detail: Eixample. Reinvented Catalan/French, local-family favorite.

blocks.title: Passeig de Gràcia architecture walk
blocks.detail: Casa Batlló and Casa Milà (La Pedrera) exteriors, Gaudí's mosaic lampposts - viewed from the street, no museum entry needed.

blocks.title: Downtime at hotel before dinner
blocks.detail: Real buffer after a full day of walking in July heat - not framed as pool time, just a rest window.

blocks.title: Dinner - MANĀ 75
blocks.detail: Barceloneta. 15+ paella varieties, bomba rice, open kitchen - explicitly built for family groups.

blocks.title: Taxi/metro to Park Güell
blocks.detail: ~30-35 min from Barceloneta.

blocks.title: Park Güell
blocks.detail: Timed-entry monumental zone, Gaudí mosaics and terraces.
blocks.notes: €18/adult, €13.50/child (7-12), free under 7 -> ~€63/$68 for the family. Book via the official site up to 90 days ahead. parkguell.barcelona

blocks.title: Lunch - La Cova Fumada
blocks.detail: Barceloneta. No-frills local tavern, seafood tapas, birthplace of the 'bomba.' Very authentic, casual with kids.

blocks.title: Barceloneta beach
blocks.detail: Blue Flag, lifeguarded, shallow entry in parts, playgrounds/climbing frames right on the sand.

blocks.title: Dinner - Cuines Santa Caterina
blocks.detail: Born, next to Santa Caterina Market. Market-driven multi-station Catalan/Mediterranean menu, big open space, good for varied kid tastes.

blocks.title: La Boqueria Market
blocks.detail: Iconic produce/seafood/tapas market off La Rambla - browse and graze rather than a formal meal.

blocks.title: Lunch - tapas stalls at La Boqueria
blocks.detail: Eating our way through the market rather than a sit-down restaurant today.

blocks.title: Gothic Quarter walk
blocks.detail: Cathedral, Plaça Sant Jaume, Plaça del Rei, then Born/Santa Caterina area - a natural ~2.5-3hr loop with kids, cobblestones so sturdy shoes.

blocks.title: Parc de la Ciutadella
blocks.detail: Real park, not a museum - the Cascada monumental fountain, the lake with rentable rowboats, wide-open lawns to run around after two city-heavy days.
blocks.notes: Rowboat rental is a few euros - small optional spend.

blocks.title: Taxi/metro back to hotel, pack for Mallorca
Dinner - Hotel Arts on-site restaurant
blocks.detail: Easy last Barcelona night, no transit needed given tomorrow's early flight.

blocks.title: Vueling - BCN -> PMI - Nonstop - 1h
blocks.detail: Barcelona -> Palma de Mallorca, Economy, 4 passengers. Vueling operates the primary nonstop service (~87 flights/week, ~1hr).
blocks.notes: Cash fare estimate ~$70/person x4 = ~$280. Iberia ended nonstop BCN-PMI service around April 2026 - Vueling, Ryanair, and Air Europa remain nonstop options.
blocks.flag: Not yet bookable - placeholder flight/time, exact 2027 schedule not published.

blocks.title: Pick up rental car - Palma Airport
blocks.detail: Needed for the Sóller and east-coast legs - neither is a walkable/transit-only base for this itinerary's day trips.
blocks.notes: Estimate: ~$45/day average x 8 days (Jul 22-30) = ~$360, adjusted to ~$340 typical peak-season small-SUV rate. Book well ahead - July is peak season.

blocks.title: Drive to Port de Sóller
blocks.detail: ~35 km via the Sóller Tunnel (toll-free), ~31-40 min.

blocks.title: Jumeirah Mallorca (Port de Sóller) - check in
blocks.detail: Family Two Bedroom Sea View Suite - 90 sqm, two connecting Junior Suites with 2 bathrooms, private terrace. Genuinely a single-unit family fit, no second room needed.
blocks.notes: No Marriott/Hyatt/Hilton presence in Port de Sóller/Tramuntana - real cash-rate booking. General hotel rates run $356-1,850+/night depending on room/season; the Family Suite specifically is estimated €900-1,400/night in July peak - budgeting the midpoint (~€1,100/$1,200) x 3 nights = ~$3,300. Unconfirmed - get a live quote.
blocks.roomType: Family Two Bedroom Sea View Suite (90 sqm)
blocks.address: Camí des Través, Port de Sóller, Mallorca, Spain
blocks.flag: Price is an estimate, not a quote - this is a real gap vs. the loyalty-points pattern used elsewhere in this trip, worth weighing against Belmond La Residencia in Deià as an alternative (similarly non-point-earning, comparable price range).

blocks.title: Settle in / Port de Sóller beach
blocks.detail: Calm horseshoe bay, gentle for young kids - light first afternoon.

blocks.title: Dinner - Randemar
blocks.detail: Port de Sóller seafront. Chef with Michelin-restaurant background, housemade pastas, wood-fired pizza, fresh fish. Crispy Sóller prawns €19, sautéed squid & prawns €25.50.

blocks.title: Antique tram - Port de Sóller to Sóller town
blocks.detail: ~14 min, runs hourly.

blocks.title: Vintage Sóller train - Sóller to Palma
blocks.detail: ~1 hour, 27 km, 13 tunnels, a 52m viaduct - the scenic mountain-crossing experience is the anchor here, not just transport.
blocks.notes: €23/person one-way (or €30 round-trip) -> ~€92-120/$100-130 for the family round-trip. Online booking opens only 7 days ahead - can't pre-book far out, note as a near-term to-do. trendesoller.com
blocks.flag: Booking only opens 7 days before travel - add a reminder rather than trying to book this now.

blocks.title: Palma old town
blocks.detail: Palma Cathedral (La Seu) exterior, old town wander - kept light, not a full sightseeing day.

blocks.title: Vintage Sóller train - Palma back to Sóller
blocks.detail: Return leg of the same round-trip ticket.

blocks.title: Antique tram back to Port de Sóller
Dinner - Ses Oliveres
blocks.detail: Port de Sóller. Second-generation family-run, fresh fish/seafood, traditional rice dishes, bay-view terrace.

blocks.title: Bike rental pickup, Port de Sóller
blocks.detail: Multiple family-friendly rental shops (Tramuntana Tours, CCT, Berganti Bikes, Can Velo) - e-bike options available if needed.

blocks.title: Bike ride - Sóller orange groves & coastal path
blocks.detail: Flat, family-friendly route through Sóller's orange groves and a relaxed coastal stretch between Sóller and Port de Sóller.
blocks.notes: Chose the bike route over the Biniaraix Gorge hike (1,932 stone steps, recommended 7-8+, a 500m+ climb) given the younger kid's age - worth keeping the gorge hike in mind for a future trip once both kids are a bit older.

blocks.title: Lunch - Patiki Beach
blocks.detail: Family-run beach bar/restaurant, farm-to-table, seasonal menu.

blocks.title: Port de Sóller beach - free afternoon
Dinner - Neni
blocks.detail: Rooftop at the Bikini Island & Mountain Hotel. Panoramic bay/Tramuntana views, shared-plate style, good variety for kids.

blocks.title: Drive to Canyamel
blocks.detail: ~95 km via mountain/interior roads - budgeting 1.5hrs realistically with a family driving pace and summer traffic (straight-line estimate is ~1h15m).

blocks.title: Cap Vermell Grand Hotel - check in
blocks.detail: Grand Suite (103-120 sqm, separate living/dining, private terrace). Note: guest reviews mention junior suites are tight for a family of 4 with an extra bed - the Grand Suite is the safer pick for real space.
blocks.notes: Former Park Hyatt Mallorca - now independent (Leading Hotels of the World), no longer earns/redeems any points. Recent tracked range €550-836/night for standard categories; Grand Suite in July peak estimated €900-1,300+/night - budgeting the midpoint (~€1,100/$1,200) x 5 nights = ~$5,500. Unconfirmed, needs a direct quote (reservations.grandhotel@capvermell.com / +34 871 811 222).
blocks.address: Urb. Atalaya de Canyamel, 07589 Capdepera, Mallorca, Spain
blocks.flag: Price is an estimate. Alternative worth weighing: Alua Calas de Mallorca Resort (World of Hyatt Inclusive Collection, further south near Manacor) has a real points-bookable Family Room sleeping 4 in one unit, roughly 17,000-30,000 points/night - but note Hyatt Inclusive Collection pricing is per-guest, not per-room, and it's a lower tier than this family's usual resort standard.

blocks.title: Settle in / beach & pool
blocks.detail: Light first afternoon.

blocks.title: Dinner - Restaurante Isabel, Canyamel
blocks.detail: Upmarket Mediterranean/Mallorcan, seasonal local ingredients - Peter's fish, sole with almond-orange sauce.

blocks.title: Drive to Porto Cristo
blocks.detail: ~20 min.

blocks.title: Coves del Drac (Drach Caves)
blocks.detail: ~1 hour, 1,200m route through stalactite/stalagmite tunnels to Lake Martel, ending with a ~10-min classical music concert performed from illuminated boats, then a boat/walk back (included).

blocks.title: Dinner - Mediterranea Cala Bona
blocks.detail: Steak, ribs, seafood paella - the owner walks guests through paella prep, a good interactive option for kids.

blocks.title: Drive to Cala Millor/Porto Cristo departure point
East-coast boat trip
blocks.detail: Coastal caves, cliffs, watchtowers, cove swim stops - some operators run glass-bottom boats.
blocks.notes: ~€25-30/person, 2-3hr trip -> ~€110-120/$115 for the family. Operators: Click-Mallorca, Mallorca Sea Paradise.

blocks.title: Dinner - Sa Caleta, Cala Bona
blocks.detail: Sea-view seafood, reasonable prices, friendly with families.

blocks.title: Beach / pool - free morning
blocks.detail: No anchor today. Cap de Formentor was considered and ruled out for this base - it's on the opposite (north) side of the island, ~1.5hr+ drive from Canyamel, and private cars are banned 10am-7pm mid-June through mid-September (shuttle/bike only) - too high-effort an add-on from here.

blocks.title: Lunch - Toni's Restaurant, Cala Millor
blocks.detail: Waterfront. Broad menu - seafood, paella, grilled meats, traditional Mallorcan.

blocks.title: Dinner - hotel restaurant, Cap Vermell
blocks.detail: Easy resort night in.

blocks.title: Dinner - Voro, Cap Vermell Grand Hotel
blocks.detail: Michelin-starred, chef Álvaro Salazar, tasting menus that evolve regularly, wine cave with 200+ references - the special send-off dinner for the trip.
blocks.notes: Tasting-menu pricing, estimate ~€90-95/person for 4 -> ~€350-380/$380-400 for the family, drinks extra. Reserve well ahead.

blocks.title: Cap Vermell Grand Hotel - check out
Drive to Palma Airport, return rental car
blocks.detail: ~1h15m-1.5h from Canyamel.

blocks.title: Vueling - PMI -> BCN - Nonstop - 1h
blocks.detail: Palma -> Barcelona, connecting to the transatlantic flight home.

blocks.title: American Airlines - BCN -> MIA - Nonstop - ~9h15m
blocks.detail: BCN -> MIA, Economy, 4 passengers. Same Alaska Atmos Rewards partner-award pattern as the outbound flight. Arrives Miami same day given the westbound time change.
blocks.notes: Estimated at 35,000 Atmos Rewards points + ~$25.60/passenger x4 = 140,000 points + ~$102.40, mirroring the outbound leg and the confirmed Rome-trip pricing pattern. Not yet live-quoted - confirm exact figure at booking.
blocks.flag: Estimate based on a comparable confirmed fare, not a live quote for this route - verify before booking.

items.name: Confirm MIA-BCN Alaska Atmos Rewards pricing
items.note: Estimated at 35,000 pts + $25.60/pax each way (mirroring the confirmed Rome-trip fare) - not yet live-quoted for this specific route/date.

items.name: Compare Hotel Arts 2-room points redemption (680,000 pts) against cash
items.note: This is the largest points ask across all 3 trip options being compared - call Marriott Reservations to ask about a Family Suite that might beat the 2-connecting-rooms math.

items.name: Get live July 2027 quotes for Jumeirah Mallorca and Cap Vermell Grand Hotel
items.note: Both are cash-only estimates (~$1,100-1,200/night each) with no live 2027 rate available yet - these are the two priciest, least-certain figures in the whole itinerary.

items.name: Weigh Alua Calas de Mallorca as a points alternative to Cap Vermell
items.note: Real Family Room sleeping 4, ~17,000-30,000 Hyatt points/night, but per-guest pricing quirk and a noticeably lower tier than this family's usual resort standard - worth a conscious tradeoff decision, not a swap-in default.
